title: Vergrim's Vexation Story
description: Vergrim's Vexation Story — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Skeer'ikt the Chirper

Quest Type: Hunt

Quest Description: Kill 28 Vergrim's Whisters in Cavernous Cavern of Caves off of level 1 of Vegrim's Vexation. Specifically you need to kill:

  • 8 Flame Brood
  • 8 Divine Whiskers
  • 8 Fire Dancers
  • 8 Crimson Spitters

Quest Reward: 3,750 Gold and 1 Kings Coins

Return to: Skeer'ikt the Chirper

Repeatable: No


after you complete this he offers you another quest of the same name:

Quest Type: Hunt

Quest Description: Kill 6 Vergrim's Champions and 2 Vegrim's Heros in Cavernous Cavern of Caves off of level 1 of Vegrim's Vexation.

Quest Reward: 7,500 Gold and 4 Kings Coins

Return to: Skeer'ikt the Chirper

Repeatable: No

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Kill 6 Champions and 2 Heroes of Vergrim's Whisker Clan Leaders and Return to Skeer'ikt the Chirper in Vergrim's Vexation off of Level 1 in the Cavernous Cavern of Caves.

Offer:

Are yous ready for yours next tasssks? Sissirats wanted me to kills some of the Clan Leaders of Vergrimses Clan. Yous will know thems when you sees thems because the are surrounded by a glowings enery at their feets. Somes glows with firey reds energy and somes glows a righteous yellows energy and they smell worses than anythings.

Before yous head offs to start with the killingses, please do Skeer'ikt a favor. Don't kills the Shamanses, they saved Skeer'ikt lifes! I hads an ingrowns whisker that pierced through my brains and the Shamanses heals me. Then they said that because of what happened I even hads been gifted with the powers of a news type of damage: Brain Damage! So, please leaves them alones, they are Skeer'ikt's friendsss.

Finds and kills these Vergrimses Clan Leaders and returns to me, Skeer'ikt the Chirper, heres in the Cavernous Cavern of Caves when you haves killed thems.

Turn-in:

Excellents! Soons I makes you an honorary Sissirats Whisker Clan member, if yous wants. Heres is some mores candies fors you.

Objectives:

  • Vergim's Champions
  • Vergrim's Heroes

Level range: 15–30
